```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(Hmisc)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
```

# load data
```{r}
micro <- read.csv("../../data/iobio/2023-12-07_mpa-aggregate.csv")
cytof <- readRDS("../../data/iobio/cytof_normalized.RDS")
```

# micro data to species level
```{r}
species <- micro[grep("s_", micro$Taxonomy),]
species <- species[-grep("t_", species$Taxonomy),]

delimiter <- "s_"
species$Taxonomy <- sub(paste0(".*", delimiter), "", species$Taxonomy)
species <- species[,-which(names(species) %in% c("TaxNum","Alternative.Tax"))]

species = reshape(data= species,
                       idvar= "sample",
                       timevar= "Taxonomy",
                       direction = "wide")
species[is.na(family)] <- 0
row_names <- c("31 _ 0", "33 _ 0", "34 _ 0", "41 _ 0", "26 _ 0", "28 _ 0", "29 _ 0", "31 _ 28", "32 _ 0", "32 _ 22", "33 _ 21", "34 _ 23")
species$'Patient ID' <- row_names
resp.id <- species[,-2:-632]
resp.id <-resp.id[-c(8,10,11,12),]

new.species <- species[,-1]
```

# merging cytof and micro data
```{r}
merged <- merge(new.species, cytof, by = "Patient ID", all = FALSE)
rownames(merged) <- merged[,1]
cytof <- merged[,-1:-633]
```

# isolated microbes of interest and baseline samples
```{r}
interest <- merged[,-1:-9]
interest <- interest[,-2:-8]
interest <- interest[,-3:-691]
interest[is.na(interest)] <- 0
interest <- interest[-c(5,7,9,11),]
cytof <- cytof[-c(5,7,9,11),]
```

# adding PPI use information
```{r}
PPI <- c("N", "N", "Y", "N", "N", "N", "NA", "Y", "Y", "Y", "Y", "N")
merged$PPI <- PPI
merged <- merged[-c(5,7,9,11),]
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate_at(c("RelAbun._Clostridium_sp_AT4", "RelAbun._Enterocloster_clostridioformis"), ~replace(.,is.na(.), 0))
```

# filtering out infiniate and NAs in cytof 
```{r}
filter <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(where(~all(is.finite(.)) && sum(!is.na(.)) > 1))
}
cytof <- filter(cytof)
```


# running correlation
```{r}
set.seed(9)
corr.results <- lapply(colnames(interest), function(x)
  lapply(colnames(cytof), function(y) cor.test(interest[[x]], cytof[[y]],
                                               method = "spearman", exact = F) %>%
           tidy() %>%
           mutate(microbe = x, cytof = y) %>%
           bind_rows())) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))
```

#Plotting significant correlation
```{r}
ggplot(merged, aes(x=`TE CD4` , y=RelAbun._Enterocloster_clostridioformis)) +
  geom_point() + stat_smooth(method = "lm", aes(group =1)) + 
  labs(x = "TE CD4 Count", y = "Relative Abundance of\nEnterocloster clostridioformis") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)
  ggsave("../../figures/2025/iobio/correlation.svg", device = "svg", height = 2, width = 6)
```



#stacked bar plot
```{r}
resp.id$PPI <- c("N","Y","Y","N","N","N","Y","N")
phyl.ra <- micro[grep("p__", micro$Taxonomy),]
phyl.ra <- phyl.ra[-grep("c__", phyl.ra$Taxonomy),]

top.phyl <- phyl.ra %>%
  group_by(Taxonomy) %>%
  summarise(med.abun = median(RelAbun, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(med.abun)) 
top.phyl <- subset(top.phyl, med.abun > 0.85)


phyl.ra <- phyl.ra %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(Taxonomy %in% top.phyl$Taxonomy, gsub("p__", "", Taxonomy), 
                         "Other")) %>% 
  left_join(resp.id)
phyl.ra$Phylum <- sub("^[^|]*\\|", "", phyl.ra$Phylum)

# reorder samples by the total relative abundance of Firmicutes
phyl.ra <- phyl.ra %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(Firmicutes_Abundance = sum(RelAbun[Phylum == "Firmicutes"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sample = fct_reorder(sample, Firmicutes_Abundance))

# order of microbes with 'other' last
phyl.ra <- phyl.ra %>%
  mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum, levels = c(
    "Firmicutes", 
    setdiff(unique(Phylum), c("Firmicutes", "Other")), 
    "Other")))

samples_to_remove <- c("DSpakowicz005_31-230123-1_R255_S4", "DSpakowicz005_32-230621-1_R255_S8", "DSpakowicz005_33-230127-1_R255_S6", "DSpakowicz005_34-230201-2_R255_S7")
phyl.ra <- phyl.ra[!(phyl.ra$sample %in% samples_to_remove),]


colors <- c("cyan4", "darkgoldenrod2", "darkgreen", "salmon2", "cornflowerblue", "deeppink4", "#999933") 

phyl.ra %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Patient ID`, y = RelAbun, fill = Phylum)) +  
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity", width = .4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) + 
  labs(x = "Patient ID", y = "") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, nrow = 7, byrow = TRUE)) + 
  facet_grid(~PPI, scales = "free_x", space = "free", switch = "x") 





ggsave("../../figures/2025/iobio/stackedbar.svg", device= "svg", height = 2.1, width = 2.64, scale = 2)
```

```{r}

immune_matrix <- t(as.matrix(cytof))


#adding ppi annotation
ppi_status <-  c("N","N","Y","N","N","Y", "Y", "N")
ppi_annotation <- data.frame(PPI = ppi_status)
rownames(ppi_annotation) <- colnames(immune_matrix)

# reorder the column bases on ppi status
ordered_columns <- order(ppi_status)  
ordered_immune_matrix <- immune_matrix[, ordered_columns]
ordered_ppi_annotation <- ppi_annotation[ordered_columns, , drop = FALSE]

annotation_colors <- list(
  PPI = c("Y" = "lightsalmon2", "N" = "slateblue2"))

svg("../../figures/2025/iobio/IC_Abundance.svg", width = 6, height = 4)

heatmap <- pheatmap(ordered_immune_matrix,
         cluster_rows = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
#         color = colorRampPalette(c("white","lightsteelblue"))(100),
#          color = rainbow(100),
#          color = viridis(100),
         color = colorRampPalette(c("lightblue","blue", "darkblue"))(100),
         fontsize_row = 6,
         fontsize_col = 6,
          legend_labels = NULL,  
         angle_col = 45, 
         annotation_col = ppi_annotation,
         annotation_colors= annotation_colors)

dev.off()
     
```





```{r}
immune <- cytof %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "sample")
ppis <- c("N","N","Y","N","N","Y", "Y", "N")
immune$PPI <- ppis

immune <- immune %>%
 pivot_longer(
   cols = where(is.numeric), 
    names_to = "immune_cell",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )

immune_comp  <- immune %>%
 group_by(sample) %>%
 mutate(relative_abundance = abundance / sum(abundance)) %>%
 ungroup()

# Assuming df_long is your long-format dataframe:
ggplot(immune_comp, aes(x = sample, y = relative_abundance, fill = immune_cell)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Immune Cell Composition by Sample",
    x = "PPI Use",
    y = "Abundance",
    fill = "Immune Cell Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # Rotate x-axis labels if needed
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),        # smaller boxes
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),     # smaller labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9)     # smaller title
  )+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  facet_grid(~PPI, scales = "free_x", space = "free", switch = "x") 
ggsave("../../figures/2025/iobio/immune_stackedbar.png", height = 3, width = 8)
```
